title: The Three Commitments
coreMove: Protect the chosen path with commitments that keep learning, ownership, and accountability attached to focused work.
sourcePressure: Part 3 frames the three commitments as protections for sustained focus over time, not blind stubbornness or intensity theater.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Confusing commitment with stubborn intensity or inventing unsupported rigid rules.

hook: A single choice changes the whole day
The real priority is hiding under the busy work
The Three Commitments as a generic focus opener
counterintuition: Focus is harder than it looks
tryThisNow: Set a timer and list priorities
Write down your one thing without a concrete context
examples: generic office worker choosing email or strategy

exampleSpecs.stakes: uncontrolled patients are disappearing between visits
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: she commits to mastering the registry query, owning the callback gaps, and reviewing misses weekly with the physician lead
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a diabetes registry export beside a phone headset and audit calendar

exampleSpecs.stakes: a cracked top repair exceeds his current skill
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: he chooses to study the repair, own the slow pace with the customer, and let the master inspect each glue stage
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a violin top clamped in a cradle beside fresh hide glue

exampleSpecs.stakes: bus routes keep opening late after storms
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: she commits to learning route software, owning resident complaints, and measuring first-pass times after each storm
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a plow route map with bus stops circled in blue grease pencil

exampleSpecs.stakes: growth will fail without a reliable prep standard
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: he stops blaming staff and commits to writing the prep standard, training it himself, and checking waste numbers every Friday
exampleSpecs.firstImage: stainless prep tubs stacked beside a handwritten waste sheet

exampleSpecs.stakes: the boat is strong but inefficient
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: she predicts harder workouts will fix it, then commits to technique study, video review, and measurable stroke changes instead
exampleSpecs.firstImage: an oar blade dripping beside a tablet paused on stroke footage

exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: he sees commitment means learning the scanner system, owning bad counts, and inviting an audit before the next truck arrives
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a handheld scanner on a pallet of tarps with mismatched labels

tryThisNowSpec: For the priority you named, write one commitment to learn the craft, one to own the result, and one to accept feedback before quitting.
